reaction.reported_reaction: Synthesis of dimethyl carbonate from methanol, propylene oxide and carbon dioxide
hydrogenation of levulinic acid to γ-valerolactone

evidence.text_snippet: γ-valerolactone was obtained with 97 % yield and 100 % selectivity under the following conditions: Levulinic acid (1.36 mmol), H₂O (20 mL), 2 MPa N₂, 130 ◦C, 6 h, Ru/NC3 (Ru 8.64 μmol)
γ-valerolactone was obtained with 97 % yield and 100 % selectivity under the following conditions: Levulinic acid (1.36 mmol), H₂O (20 mL), 2 MPa N₂, 130 ◦C, 6 h, Ru/NC3 (Ru 8.64 μmol)
The best results were obtained with Ru/NC3 for the hydrogenation of levulinic acid
At 160 ◦C and 0.1 % sulfuric acid, the Co- SACs achieved a monophenol yield of 41.7 %
